description.p: Watcher is a cinematic media discovery application featuring curated catalogs, AI assistant recommendations, smart stats, and multi-device cloud synchronization.

ul.li: Discover trending, top-rated, and upcoming movies & TV series.
Smart Watchlist, Viewing History, and Continued Watching progress tracking.
AI-powered movie recommendations and conversational assistant.
Optional Google account sign-in for seamless multi-device sync across Desktop, Web, and Mobile.

description.p: Added multi-device cloud synchronization, Debian package (.deb), and Flatpak support.
